headline: GR.EC.A.: Reactions to the ban on cash payments for cash on delivery – risk of distorting competition
summary: The Hellenic Electronic Commerce Association (GR.EC.A.) backs stronger electronic payments but warns that a ban on cash payments for cash on delivery risks distorting competition.
why: E-commerce payment rules shape how online retailers and delivery platforms operate, affecting costs, competition and tax compliance.
